name: MonarchMethodBadge
title: MethodBadge
summary: An HTTP method label (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) in the code typeface, with a tone per method.
whenToUse: In endpoint lists, API references and request logs, before the path of a request.
whenNotToUse: Not for a status in words (use MonarchBadge) and not for an HTTP status code. It is not a button.
api: init(_ method: String, tone: MonarchTone? = nil)
nonisolated static func tone(for method: String) -> MonarchTone

options.name: method
options.description: The HTTP method in any case. It is trimmed and shown in upper case.

options.name: tone
options.description: Replaces the tone chosen from the method. nil keeps GET success, POST info, PUT and PATCH warning, DELETE danger and everything else neutral.

appearance: A rounded rectangle with the tone's subtle fill, strong text and border; the neutral tone is the muted background with muted text and no border. The same roles are used in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named MonarchBadge as the base. MonarchBadge is a capsule in the caption role and cannot take the code typeface or a minimum width, so this component draws its own surface from the same tone palette. The web's sm and md sizes are not offered: the text is the code role (14 points) and follows Dynamic Type. Android uses the same name and tones.
accessibility: Read as the method name, which is always the visible text, so colour is never the only signal.
The text scales with Dynamic Type; the minimum width scales with it.
Not interactive: it has no button trait and no action.
edgeCases: A method outside GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE is neutral, including HEAD and OPTIONS.
An empty method draws an empty badge at the minimum width.
A long method wraps inside the badge and is centred; real methods are one word.
With a custom code font family in the theme typography, that family is used.

examples.title: Every method
examples.template:
MonarchFlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.0}})
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.1}})
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.2}})
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.3}})
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.4}})
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.5}})
    MonarchMethodBadge({{methods.6}})
}
examples.code:
MonarchFlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
    MonarchMethodBadge("GET")
    MonarchMethodBadge("POST")
    MonarchMethodBadge("PUT")
    MonarchMethodBadge("PATCH")
    MonarchMethodBadge("DELETE")
    MonarchMethodBadge("HEAD")
    MonarchMethodBadge("OPTIONS")
}
